info.name: REST Countries Middleware API
info.description: Requests that exercise every endpoint, validation rule and error of the middleware. Each request has tests, so the whole collection can be run with the Collection Runner. Change the "baseUrl" collection variable if the API does not run on port 3000.

request.description: Flat contract with neighbors resolved by name and sorted by name; density rounded to 2 decimals.

exec: pm.test("json.neighbors.map(n => n.name).join() === 'Belize,El Salvador,Honduras,Mexico'", () => pm.expect(!!(json.neighbors.map(n => n.name).join() === 'Belize,El Salvador,Honduras,Mexico')).to.be.true);

pm.test("json.densityPerKm2 === Math.round(json.population / json.areaKm2 * 100) / 100", () => pm.expect(!!(json.densityPerKm2 === Math.round(json.population / json.areaKm2 * 100) / 100)).to.be.true);

pm.test("json.neighbors.every((n, i, a) => i === 0 || a[i - 1].name.localeCompare(n.name) <= 0)", () => pm.expect(!!(json.neighbors.every((n, i, a) => i === 0 || a[i - 1].name.localeCompare(n.name) <= 0))).to.be.true);

request.description: Abkhazia has an empty alpha-3 code in the provider and is discarded.
